title: CoolSynth Listening Pass, round 2
intro: Your notes from the first round, fixed. Each card is a before and after or a plain question. Tape Flute, High Voice and Four-Track House are gone, as you asked; all 134 cards of round 1 are done.

groups.title: The clicks
groups.intro: Both clicks had one cause: a key struck again while its recording still rang jumped back to the recording's start. Now the old ring fades out over 5 ms under the new strike, which rises as a fresh note does.

groups.title: Your other notes
groups.intro: Bedroom Bass opened up, Washed Poly's noise down by a quarter, and the Ladder card kept as a preset.

items.title: Vibraphone: the phrase you heard clicks in

tries.label: One key struck again and again

listen: The same notes as round 1, keys repeating while they ring; the try strikes one key over and over.

items.title: Granular Sky: the chord change

tries.label: One key struck again and again

listen: The click was where the second chord strikes G3 again while the first chord's G3 still releases.

items.title: Steinway Grand: a repeated key
listen: The same fix on the piano, which ticked on repeated keys too (found by my test, not by your ear).

items.title: Bedroom Bass, opened up
listen: ▶ Play is the new one (ladder at 700 Hz, less deep sub), played from C3; the first try is how it was. Both are levelled the same way.

items.title: Washed Poly, a little less noise
listen: Crackle and hiss down by a quarter, as you asked: slightly less, not much less.

items.title: Ladder Chords, the new Studio 1982 preset
listen: The Ladder card you liked, as a preset: ▶ Play is exactly what you heard. Its macros: Drive (to 24 dB), Cutoff, Resonance, Release.
items.keys: Its macros: pad Home, page Macros, knobs 1 to 4
